title: Swarm: list Consul + Nomad ACL tokens (protected flagged)
description: Runs `nexus acl swarm list`. Merges `consul acl token list` + `nomad acl token list`; bootstrap/agent/anonymous/management tokens are flagged protected.

observe.what: merged token table; agent + bootstrap + anonymous tokens carry the protected tag

whatProves: SwarmAdapter.AclAsync(list) parses both ACL engines (ParseConsulAclTokens + ParseNomadAclTokens) and marks the cluster/operator-identity tokens revoke-protected.
